title: Earthborne Rangers
subtitle: An open-world cooperative card game set in the wilderness of the far future
tagline: Protect the Valley, Forge Your Path
loreSummary: You are a Ranger, a protector of the Valley in a far-future Earth reborn. Your choices and actions will shape the wilderness and its inhabitants as you explore its secrets.
keyFeatures: Deck-building focused on exploration and survival
Persistent world where choices carry weight

earthborne_standard.name: Standard Campaign
earthborne_standard.description: The main story arc taking you across the Valley, completing core objectives.

earthborne_extended.name: Extended Exploration
earthborne_extended.description: Taking time to explore more side paths, side missions, and uncovering deeper secrets.
